title: Doppler on Apple Watch: your VPN, from your wrist
metaTitle: VPN on Apple Watch: Control Doppler VPN From Your Wrist
metaDescription: The Doppler Apple Watch app connects and disconnects the VPN on your iPhone, switches servers, shows live traffic and runs a speed test. How to install it and what it can and cannot do.
excerpt: Connect, switch servers, watch your traffic and test your speed from your wrist. The tunnel stays on your iPhone.

faq.question: Does the Apple Watch app run its own VPN?
faq.answer: No. It is a remote for the VPN on your paired iPhone. The watch sends a command, the iPhone does the work and answers with its current state.

faq.question: Which watchOS version do I need?
faq.answer: watchOS 26, with the Doppler app installed and signed in on the paired iPhone.

faq.question: Can I connect from the watch on a free plan?
faq.answer: Connecting from the watch needs Doppler Pro. On a free plan the watch tells you so and nothing connects. You can still open the app and see your devices and profile.

faq.question: Can I remove a device from the watch?
faq.answer: No. Removing a device, and every other setting, stays on the iPhone on purpose.
